actions: Deploy NAS security enhancements with NAS security mode extension (NSE) for integrity protection.
Enforce NAS security mode 3 or 4 for all UE attachments in core/RAN.
Configure RAN to reject NAS messages with unexpected EMM state transitions.
Implement NAS trace analysis with a threshold of <100 EMM state 128eea1 occurrences per hour.
Block IMSI catcher signatures via RRC security alerts for suspicious cells.
Enable NAS replay attack detection with a counter limit of 3 retries per session.
Restrict NAS emergency attachment to authorized emergency services only.
Deploy NAS authentication failure rate KPI monitoring with a threshold of 5%.
Update core/RAN to enforce NAS security mode enforcement for all UEs.
Trigger automated RAN cell blacklisting for repeated NAS anomaly detections.

mapped_mitigations.fgm_name: Discard RAN Signaling Received Without Integrity Protection
